subject: Re: Kickoff: Lighthouse relighting primitive — status + license blocker
body:
Dmitri, Santiago,

Status:

- InteriorNet milestone hit Mar 26. Pretrained model runs on the .npz test set and our predicted lighting volumes match the released outputs visually and in per-scene RGB error.
- Retraining path: train.py runs on 20 of our own capture pairs; relit composites look right at the coarse volume scales, some haloing at the finest scale that Hyun is chasing.

Blocker: confirmed that completing the code release requires following the third-party instructions in nets.py and geometry/projector.py — that code is not Apache 2 licensed. Kofi (cc'd), we need a read on whether we can use it internally-only for the demo while Hyun's clean-room reimplementation lands. Reimplementation estimate holds at 3 weeks, which threatens the May 22 integration demo unless we start now.

Recommend a quick decision call this week.

Yusuf
